title: The Result of Coveting Little Advantages
simplified_paragraphs: 小张是个爱贪小便宜的人。有一天，小张领了不少薪水，小李知道后想让小张请客吃饭。小张没办法，只好答应了。
小张和小李一起吃饭时，小张对小李说："这顿饭我请客，可是下次你拿薪水了，一定也要请我吃饭啊！”
一段时间后，小李领了薪水。他记着之前的约定，所以就请小张去吃饭。可是没想到这次吃饭小张花的钱更多。原来这次因为是小李请客，于是他疯狂地吃，结果吃太饱了，把胃撑出了问题，最后只能去医院看医生了。
traditional_paragraphs: 小張是個愛貪小便宜的人。有一天，小張領了不少薪水，小李知道後想讓小張請客吃飯。小張沒辦法，只好答應了。
小張和小李一起吃飯時，小張對小李說："這頓飯我請客，可是下次你拿薪水了，一定也要請我吃飯啊！”
一段時間後，小李領了薪水。他記著之前的約定，所以就請小張去吃飯。可是沒想到這次吃飯小張花的錢更多。原來這次因為是小李請客，於是他瘋狂地吃，結果吃太飽了，把胃撐出了問題，最後只能去醫院看醫生了。
pinyin_paragraphs: xiǎo zhāng shì gè ài tān xiǎo pián yi de rén。 yǒu yī tiān， xiǎo zhāng lǐng le bù shǎo xīn shui， xiǎo lǐ zhī dào hòu xiǎng ràng xiǎo zhāng qǐng kè chī fàn。 xiǎo zhāng méi bàn fǎ， zhǐ hǎo dā ying le。
xiǎo zhāng hé xiǎo lǐ yī qǐ chī fàn shí， xiǎo zhāng duì xiǎo lǐ shuō：" zhè dùn fàn wǒ qǐng kè， kě shì xià cì nǐ ná xīn shui le， yī dìng yě yào qǐng wǒ chī fàn a！”

yī duàn shí jiān hòu， xiǎo lǐ lǐng le xīn shui。 tā jì zhe zhī qián de yuē dìng， suǒ yǐ jiù qǐng xiǎo zhāng qù chī fàn。 kě shì méi xiǎng dào zhè cì chī fàn xiǎo zhāng huā de qián gèng duō。 yuán lái zhè cì yīn wèi shì xiǎo lǐ qǐng kè， yú shì tā fēng kuáng de chī， jié guǒ chī tài bǎo le， bǎ wèi chēng chū le wèn tí， zuì hòu zhǐ néng qù yī yuàn kàn yī shēng le。
english_paragraphs: Xiao Zhang was always looking for ways to get a little something for free. One day, he received a sizable paycheck. When Xiao Li found out, he asked Xiao Zhang to treat him to a meal. Xiao Zhang had no choice but to agree.
While they were eating, Xiao Zhang said to Xiao Li, “I’m paying for this meal, but when you get paid, you have to treat me too!”

Some time later, Xiao Li got paid. Remembering their agreement, he took Xiao Zhang out to eat. But unexpectedly, Xiao Zhang ended up spending even more money this time. Since Xiao Li was paying, Xiao Zhang ate as much as he could. He ate so much that he made himself sick and had to go to the hospital.
english_full:
Xiao Zhang was always looking for ways to get a little something for free. One day, he received a sizable paycheck. When Xiao Li found out, he asked Xiao Zhang to treat him to a meal. Xiao Zhang had no choice but to agree.

While they were eating, Xiao Zhang said to Xiao Li, “I’m paying for this meal, but when you get paid, you have to treat me too!”

Some time later, Xiao Li got paid. Remembering their agreement, he took Xiao Zhang out to eat. But unexpectedly, Xiao Zhang ended up spending even more money this time. Since Xiao Li was paying, Xiao Zhang ate as much as he could. He ate so much that he made himself sick and had to go to the hospital.
